finding: Feature Universe says “47 connected screens” and “Public live + deterministic fallback” despite no production-connected route/provider evidence.
required_action: Separate draft hotfix: replace with truthful preview/prototype wording and regression tests.

finding: Live market UI contains hard-coded INR tape prices/percentages and “Live watch universe” wording.
impact: Static values can be mistaken for current market observations.
required_action: Separate draft hotfix: label deterministic demo and derive all displayed values from truth-labelled response.

finding: LiveMarketService silently returns fixture data after provider error, though fallback reason is included in metadata.
impact: Consumers may ignore metadata and display realistic fixtures as live.
required_action: Provider failure must return UNAVAILABLE/STALE unless user explicitly selected DEMO; add schema and UI regression tests.

finding: TradingView Lightweight Charts is loaded from an unpinned unpkg URL at runtime without SRI.
impact: External script substitution and outage risk.
required_action: Pin exact version and integrity or self-host audited package; CSP and offline fallback.
blocks_prompt2b: no for calculators; yes before connected release

finding: Branch protection REST endpoint was inaccessible to the read-only Actions token and no rulesets were visible.
impact: Required-check enforcement cannot be proven by this audit.
required_action: Owner verifies branch protection/rules with administrative UI or authorized API.

finding: Public market adapters exist without completed commercial/redistribution/geographic review.
impact: Use may violate provider terms or regional restrictions.
required_action: Legal/source-specific approval before enablement or redistribution.
blocks_prompt2b: no for deterministic Wave 1; yes for provider waves

finding: Broker/wallet/exchange connections lack OAuth/PKCE/state, least-privilege scopes, KMS token storage, revocation and deletion implementations.
impact: Account compromise/overbroad access if implemented ad hoc.
required_action: Implement only in Wave 4 behind security architecture and read-only scopes.

finding: Parallel legacy and qelly_* organization/workspace tables require ownership and migration reconciliation.
impact: Ambiguous canonical entities and migration drift.
required_action: Document canonical tables, migration path, rollback and data consistency checks.

finding: 187 API contracts exist, but authorization/tenant-isolation evidence is not complete per endpoint.
required_action: Endpoint-by-endpoint auth/tenant tests before connected beta.
blocks_prompt2b: no for unauthenticated deterministic calculators; yes for persistence features

finding: No hard-coded production credential was detected by exact-head secret scan; test/example secrets exist by design.
required_action: Keep secrets server-side and scans mandatory.

finding: Real-money trading, custody, deposits/withdrawals, private-key/seed storage and autonomous execution remain disabled.
impact: Catastrophic if enabled without separate program.
